name: Feldspar-Maw
specific_features: Starship crash site (colony ship, warship, freighter)
description: Feldspar-Maw is a mid-sized volcanic world whose surface is dominated by a single enormous rift that splits the planet nearly pole to pole, exposing deep mantle rock veined with feldspar crystals the size of buildings. The rift floor seethes with magma flows and geothermal vents, while the walls on either side rise kilometers high, banded in pinks, whites, and grays. The planet's core is partially exposed at the rift's deepest point, a glowing mass of molten metal visible through shimmering heat distortion.

The toxic atmosphere carries a persistent ashen haze that turns the sky a burnt orange. Heat radiates from the ground in visible waves, and the rift generates its own weather system, superheated updrafts that create perpetual ash-thunderstorms along the rim. The microbial life here is invisible to the eye but present in staggering density, coating every warm surface in heat-resistant biofilms.

A colony transport ship, the MSV Feldspar's Promise, crashed into the western rift wall sixty years ago during an attempted emergency landing. The wreck is partially embedded in the cliff face, its hull slowly being consumed by mineral accretion. The ship's manifest listed three thousand colonists in cryosleep; the pods were never recovered, and the wreck is now considered a mass grave.

Salvage rights to the Feldspar's Promise are legally contested by the colonists' descendants and the shipping company's insurers. The wreck's location makes recovery operations extraordinarily dangerous, but the ship's reactor core and cargo hold may still contain valuable materials. The microbial biofilms have begun colonizing the wreck itself, raising questions about contamination and biological quarantine that further complicate any recovery effort.
